texts.bt_a_already_paid: Already paid. Do not pay it again.
texts.bt_a_expired: Expired. The ticket was not cashed in time.
texts.bt_a_not_valid: Not valid. The operator does not know this ticket.
texts.bt_a_pending: Not finished. Some games are still playing.
texts.bt_a_refer: This win of {amount} is above the shop's limit. Refer it to head office.
texts.bt_a_short_of_cash: The drawer does not hold {amount}. Refer it, or pay when cash is topped up.
texts.bt_approver: Who approves? A manager or the owner, never the person serving.
texts.bt_cancel_no: This bet can no longer be cancelled.
texts.bt_collect: The operator sent the cash. The winner collects it here with their code.
texts.bt_coming: LynkBet starts here once a licensed operator is signed.
texts.bt_commission_note: An estimate. The operator pays the commission and its statement decides.
texts.bt_confirmed: Bet confirmed. The ticket is printing.
texts.bt_dispute_sent: Sent to the operator. The customer can follow each step.
texts.bt_failed: The operator did not accept the bet. Nothing was taken.
texts.bt_flag_big: Many payouts close to the shop's limit.
texts.bt_flag_note: A flag is never an accusation.
texts.bt_keep: The customer keeps the original ticket until it is paid.
texts.bt_lock_failed: The operator did not lock it. Do not pay.
texts.bt_locked_note: Only the operator's amount is paid. It cannot be changed.
texts.bt_low_cash: Cash in the drawer is running low.
texts.bt_needs_net: Betting needs an internet connection. Nothing is saved for later.
texts.bt_never_credit: Bets are never taken on credit.
texts.bt_offline_mode: No internet. Bets are taken as queued slips until the counter is back online. Payouts wait.
texts.bt_paid: Paid. The ticket is now closed.
texts.bt_photos_note: The photos go only to the operator.
texts.bt_queued_note: No internet. The slip goes to the operator when the counter is back online. If the operator refuses it, the customer gets all their money back.
texts.bt_safer_age: Only people aged {age} or over may bet. Ask for an ID when unsure.
texts.bt_safer_exclude: A customer who chose to stop betting cannot place a bet.
texts.bt_safer_limits: Customers can set their own limits and take a break of 1, 7 or 30 days with the operator.
texts.bt_scan_hint: Hold the ticket's code under the scanner below the screen.
texts.bt_second_needed: Payouts of {amount} or more need a second staff member.
texts.bt_sf_note: What anyone can see on your shop's page, only where the law allows. No odds, offers or promotions.
texts.bt_slip_empty: Tap the odds of a game to add it.
texts.bt_slip_operator_off: The operator has switched offline slips off.
texts.bt_slip_shop_cap: The shop's offline limit is used up.
texts.bt_slip_slip_cap: This stake is above the operator's offline limit.
texts.bt_slip_starts_soon: This game starts too soon for an offline slip.
texts.bt_take_momo: The customer pays {amount} by mobile money.
texts.bt_try: Sandbox operators, sample games, test money only. Pick a sample ticket below to scan it, or switch the internet off to take a queued slip.
